published.citation: Barber et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HIP 67522 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive: 5675 +/- 75 K, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJ...973L..30B/abstract

temperature.note: No archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 120411 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), so the colour is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
